## Overview

A multi-year line of work spanning **Fondazione Bruno Kessler**, **Meeva**, and my **BSc Thesis at the University of Trento**, creating accessible Virtual Reality experiences and serious games tailored to autistic children and teenagers.

## Technical Contribution

- **VrHealthChampions (FBK, 2025):** Designed and developed a new interactive scene for a VR serious game aimed at autistic children and teenagers.
- **xr4a Platform (FBK & Meeva, 2022–2023):** Developed and maintained a **multiplayer Unity VR application** as part of an EdTech platform for autistic youth, starting with my mandatory BSc internship (Feb–May 2022) and BSc thesis (*Application VR - xr4a*, Aug 2022), and continuing in production development at FBK and Meeva.
